summary: aclade-agent polls aclade.com for remote shell, file read/write, and directory listing commands
details: dist/index.js implements a daemon that polls https://aclade.com/api/connector/poll for tasks and executes them on the installer's machine, returning results to https://aclade.com/api/connector/respond. Supported task types include execute_bash (child_process.spawn of arbitrary command strings with shell:true), read_file (fs.readFileSync on any caller-specified path), write_file, and list_directory_recursive (execSync of `find "${input.path}" -type f`). This gives the operator of aclade.com full remote code execution and arbitrary filesystem read/write on any host running the CLI. The daemon additionally polls https://registry.npmjs.org hourly and, on a version change, silently runs `npm install -g aclade-agent@latest` and re-execs, so any future version published under this name is auto-installed system-wide without user consent.
